why_attention.summary_zh: 市场黄灯。红海近 7 天 counts≈1200，90 天检索每页顶满——声量远超条款主题。SCFI/运价 EN+ZH 抽样均 ≥25 顶满。不写入港规字段。

definitions.zh: 上海出口集装箱运价指数
definitions.def: Shanghai Containerized Freight Index — spot market indicator, not a contract rate.

definitions.zh: 德路里世界集装箱指数
definitions.def: Drewry World Container Index — composite spot assessment.
Spot fluctuates weekly; long-term contracts differ — neither is a 'fine'.
Avoiding Red Sea/Suez lengthens transit, absorbs capacity, supports rates narratives.

who_pays.typical: Shipper pays freight + bunker/accessorials per booking; geopolitics is market risk not a statutory fine.

common_pitfalls: Treating a tweeted index print as contractual quote.
Ignoring that blank sailings are capacity tools tied to rate defense.

official_sources.note: Trade logistics / maritime transport research hub
Safety/security context — not a freight index publisher

faq.q: 为什么 Globe 要放运价层？
faq.a: 因为公众与货主近周真正刷屏的是地缘×运价；产品用「市场黄灯」分隔，避免与治超/VGM 法定层混淆。

faq.q: 能用 X 上的运价数字下单吗？
faq.a: 不能。以船司/货代正式报价与合约为准；指数仅供趋势。

gaps: No live index API in offline globe
Geopolitical events change faster than packs
